*.branch_id: A br-... id, not a name.

countProjects.org_id: Organization id from {{user.organizations}}; required with a personal API key.

createCredential.scopes: Capabilities to grant. The credential may only perform actions in these scopes.

createProjectBranchFunctionDeployment.runtime: The Node.js runtime for the deployment.
createProjectBranchFunctionDeployment.zip: Base64-encoded ZIP of the function source. Omit to reuse the latest bundle; required for the first deployment.

deleteProjectBranchBucketObjectsByPrefix.prefix: Key prefix to delete, ending in / (for example app/avatars/).

getConsumptionHistoryPerBranchV2.granularity: hourly reaches back 168 hours, daily 60 days, monthly one year.
getConsumptionHistoryPerBranchV2.metrics: Metric names from the tool description; any other returns HTTP 400. extra_branches_month and snapshot_storage_bytes_month are only on {{consumption.perProjectV2}}.

getConsumptionHistoryPerProjectV2.project_ids: Up to 100 project ids. Omit for every project with history in the organization, including deleted ones.
getConsumptionHistoryPerProjectV2.granularity: hourly reaches back 168 hours, daily 60 days, monthly one year.
getConsumptionHistoryPerProjectV2.metrics: Metric names from the tool description. An unknown name returns no data rather than an error.

listProjects.org_id: Organization id from {{user.organizations}}; required with a personal API key.

removeProjectMemberRole.confirm_self_lockout: Set true to remove your own grant when you would lose manage access.

setProjectMemberRole.confirm_self_demotion: Set true to lower your own role on the project.

updateNeonAuthEmailProvider.body: Email provider configuration for the branch's Neon Auth integration.

updateProjectBranch.expires_at: The timestamp when the branch is scheduled to expire and be automatically deleted.

updateProjectBranchFunction.name: New display name for the function.

updateSnapshot.expires_at: The date and time when the snapshot will expire.

listProjectBranchBucketObjects.delimiter: Groups keys up to this delimiter, usually /, into folders.
